qa_audit.ip_note: The client brand "THE LONG WAY ROUND" with a road-trip / campervan travel theme is confusingly close to the well-known real travel-media franchise "Long Way Round" (Ewan McGregor & Charley Boorman's 2004 series, which spawned Long Way Down / Long Way Up). As a branded travel/road-trip media property it reads as an existing franchise rather than an invented client. Recommend renaming the fictional podcast brand to something unambiguous (e.g. "Wander Miles", "Detour Diaries").

Self-noted minor nits (step 13 select_subject on a uniform texture plate has no salient subject; step 20 puts an SVG on a Firefly board) are cosmetic and non-blocking.
